# Smart Timetable Scheduler Application

This is a professional timetable management application for Smart Timetable Scheduler with the following features:

## Features
- Google Authentication (restricted to @email.com domains)
- Subject Management
- Class Scheduling
- Faculty Assignment
- Professional UI Design
- Real-time Timetable Updates

## Technology Stack
- React with TypeScript
- Firebase Authentication
- Material-UI for professional design
- React Router for navigation
- Context API for state management
